The '''Althir system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Rolion sector/Legends|Rolion sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the planet [[Althir III]], homeworld of the [[Althiri]].
